Gideon later encountered hostility from the men of Penuel during his pursuit of the Midianites (Judg 8:8–9, 17), and Jeroboam fortified the city (1 Kgs 12:25). The name also belongs to two individuals in the Chronicler's genealogies (1 Chr 4:4; 8:25). The LXX rendering 'eidos theou' (form of God) in Genesis preserves the etymological meaning."
